answer: Problem: cloned agents flood tallies. Mechanism: each agent docks three equal stake parcels on a jetty bond into a shared vault; a gale of 7 peer probes then stress-tests the bond path for one full epoch and only parcels that survive every probe count toward vote weight. Cost: 1.2% of spendable locked until probes clear. Verification: vault receipt hash plus probe quorum signatures must match the epoch checkpoint. Failure: early withdrawal or a synthetic probe path slashes all three parcels 40% and voids the votes.
